content:
Hey all, I haven't been able to come to many of the recent meetings due to time conflicts with my job, but I have still been making some progress on extractability for Merkle trees.

Currently the PR has broken the proof down into some nontrivial but manageable portions. A few more autoformalization tools have been announced and I know we've had some companies work on resolving our sorrys before, so I thought I might stop and ask if that is something I could trigger on my PR, or if I should just try to merge the PR with sorries included so that maybe they will be targeted in a large-scale ATP pass in the future.
